```python
"""Smoke tests for parallel_desktop_server FastAPI app."""
import sys
import os
import pytest
from httpx import AsyncClient, ASGITransport
from unittest.mock import AsyncMock, MagicMock, patch

# Ensure project root is on path
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))

from parallel_desktop_server import app


def _make_mock_canvas():
    """Return a MagicMock that simulates a live AsyncParallelDesktop."""
    mock = MagicMock()
    mock.page = MagicMock()
    mock.page.url = "http://example.com"
    mock.set_status = AsyncMock()
    mock.navigate = AsyncMock()
    mock.capture = AsyncMock(return_value={
        "success": True, "path": "/tmp/x.png",
        "width": 1240, "height": 800, "error": None
    })
    mock.transcribe = AsyncMock(return_value={
        "success": True, "text": "", "elements": []
    })
    mock.width = 1240
    mock.height = 800
    mock.cursor_pos = (0, 0)
    return mock


@pytest.fixture
async def async_client():
    mock_canvas = _make_mock_canvas()
    mock_session = MagicMock()
    mock_session.task_name = "smoke"
    mock_session.started_at = 0.0

    with patch("parallel_desktop_server.canvas", mock_canvas), \
         patch("parallel_desktop_server.eyes.start_task", return_value=mock_session), \
         patch("parallel_desktop_server.eyes.end_task", return_value=0), \
         patch("parallel_desktop_server.eyes._ACTIVE_TASK_SESSION", None):
        async with AsyncClient(
            transport=ASGITransport(app=app), base_url="http://test"
        ) as client:
            yield client


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_health_returns_200(async_client):
    resp = await async_client.get("/health")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    assert resp.json()["status"] == "ok"


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_navigate_rejects_non_http(async_client):
    resp = await async_client.post("/navigate", json={"url": "ftp://bad.example.com"})
    assert resp.status_code == 400


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_click_out_of_bounds(async_client):
    resp = await async_client.post("/click", json={"x": 9999, "y": 9999})
    assert resp.status_code == 422


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_task_start_has_task_id(async_client):
    resp = await async_client.post("/task/start", json={"task_name": "smoke"})
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert "task_id" in body


@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_task_end_returns_deleted_count(async_client):
    resp = await async_client.post("/task/end")
    assert resp.status_code == 200
    body = resp.json()
    assert "deleted_screenshots" in body
```
